features.title: Plugin updates waiting for a Host restart
features.summary: A Plugins-page row names every plugin whose browser half rebuilt while its Host half still runs from before the rebuild, so the page keeps the last-good client code instead of running new client code against old Host code.
failureModes: A rebuilt client bundle whose Host half did not change applies immediately, as before.
A rebuilt client bundle whose Host half changed is announced as deferred; the browser keeps the last-good code and the row names the package until a Host restart.
A Host that reloads the package in-process releases the deferral and announces the rebuild.
